purpose: Design-only participant positioning semantics for potential future FUTOI-derived Phase 2 features.

semantic_boundary.open_interest_rule: No open interest interpretation is allowed without a separate PM-approved open-interest source and contract.

source_id_mapping.mapping_rule: positioning.moex_algopack_futoi_raw may map into futoi.participant_positioning only as a raw provider-family alias after a later source/provider contract approves exact schema, timestamps, and revision behavior.

candidate_feature_semantics_design_only.meaning: Direction of participant positioning change after PIT-safe availability.
Relative pressure or imbalance in participant positioning after PIT-safe availability.
Potential divergence between participant groups, if the later approved schema supports it.

availability_rule.conservative_rule_if_release_ts_unresolv: If exact release timestamp is unresolved, shift by at least one trading day or exclude from the export.
availability_rule.d1_anchor_rule: D1 trade_date T is usable only from T+1 06:00 Europe/Moscow or later unless a later approved FUTOI source contract imposes a stricter lag.

pit_and_revision_requirements_for_future: Exact release timestamp or conservative lag rule.
Join key to USDRUBF / Si trade date.
Explicit handling of holidays and missing reports.
Schema proof that fields represent participant positioning, not open interest.
